title: Contact Finish With Pad
description: A coach holds a soft pad to create realistic light contact as players finish through it, building confidence finishing through a bump at the rim.

content.objective: Finish through realistic light contact without losing balance or shot technique.
content.setup: A coach or teammate holds a soft contact pad at the block; the shooter drives from the wing.
instructions: Drive from the wing toward the rim at game speed.
Accept light contact from the pad on the way up through the shot.
Finish strong through the pad, protecting the ball with the off-arm.
Rotate so every player gets several reps through the pad.
coachingPoints: Gather the ball with both hands before the contact arrives.
Finish through the shot, don't flinch away from the pad.
Use the off-arm to create space, not to push off illegally.
commonMistakes: Slowing down before contact instead of attacking through it.
Losing the ball on contact from loose handling.
Rushing the last two steps instead of gathering under control.
content.safety: The pad holder applies only light, controlled pressure — never a hard check.
